verify_recipe: Read the anchor wallet on the explorer or RPC (getSignaturesForAddress, then getTransaction). Each anchor is an spl-memo: PHI-LEDGER|seal=<name>|sha256=<ledger snapshot hash>|by=tyofthestarz. A seal is anchored when its name appears with a sha256 that exists in the ledger snapshot history.
note: CookieScan reads are public; this key is Azpen's signed coordinate into Tyree's chain record, derived from the live ledger state. It rotates when a new seal changes the snapshot hash — reissue per seal.
